about: LastResetReason comes from the platform (`reset_reason`, on the ESP32 esp_reset_reason()) and goes into Booted and the attribute, with the values of types/0x0001-device.md §2.4 — BROWNOUT is 4. Until 2026-10-03 the C constants were shifted (SOFTWARE 1, BROWNOUT 3) and the node always said POWER_ON.
